steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Legend has it that there's an amusement park for monsters.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: But... She's not sure if she can find the happiness that belongs to monsters in that place, the happiness that never ends.
In the darkness, Serpent's voice turns doleful. You seem to see the girl who wandered around the bright streets of Eastside looking for happiness.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: The girl is strange-looking and has been so from birth, with her unusual eyes and ears, and her peculiar birthmarks. This has made her an object of ridicule and a source of fear.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: She has always been an outsider. That's why she couldn't find her own happiness among humans.
There seem to be objects swimming in the darkness around you. Slowly but surely, they come together to build a scene you're only too familiar with.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Is this the Endless Carnival?!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Yes... Endless Carnival, an amusement park for monsters. Surely they'll welcome me and let me find happiness?
Serpent's voice merges with that of the character in the story again.
The eyes on stage are lightless, but filled with longing.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Serpent, you won't be able to get in there.
"Serpent" hears you and turns around, smiling down at you from the stage.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I am... a human?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Are you dreaming?
Serpent moves on ahead, as the Corruptors in the park stir.
They notice the presence of an unwelcome intruder and come rushing over to chase her out.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Why... why are they turning me out?!
Her puny body is swaying, and her face, arms and abdomen have been lacerated by the Corruptors.
From beyond the warped gate of the park come furious shouts.

steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: Get out! Get out! You don't belong here! This amusement park is not for you!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Serpent, stop!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Or you will be consumed by the Corruptors! That's not the kind of amusement park you have in mind!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It will only... bring you... the present you... even more pain.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Ha...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Why... Why?!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Happiness... happiness is a luxury, something out of a sweet dream.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I've tried so hard to find happiness for myself. But still, I can't have sweet dreams, can't experience true happiness!
Serpent makes many more dashes for the park. Each time, she is knocked down and dragged out.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I just...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Just...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I just want to be happy... Forever...!!
Serpent lies outside the gate, too spent to pick herself up again. She stares blankly at the gray skies, as the sound of snakes, rats, and all sorts of insects crawling gets closer and closer.
Her emotions, her feelings, her obsession... all are being conveyed to you through the shackles, the whole kit and caboodle.
You clench your teeth, eyes red, feeling everything she has been put through.
Serpent is now lying at the edge of the Rust in the darkness surrounding Endless Carnival, motionless like a corpse but burning with desire for happiness.
You're about to wake Serpent up when you hear a sound that makes your hair stand on end.
It's the flapping of wings. You sense that Serpent is aroused by the sound, who raises her head and looks ahead...
Ahead is something you've seen before. Looks like it's been drawn here by Serpent's obsession. It releases some kind of crystal-clear liquid from its wiggling mouthpart.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Marv?! It's releasing Ambrosia! Serpent, get out of here...!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Sweet... so sweet...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I like the taste... Is this... my happiness...?

steps.speaker: Marv
steps.content: Hehe... Happiness, happiness, this is... happiness, you like it.
The next second, you and Serpent are transported by Marv to a pure white Realm of Dreams.
Serpent is still sitting on the ground seiza-style, murmuring about the taste of happiness, indifferent to the new landscape.

steps.speaker: Marv
steps.content: Strange, very strange...

steps.speaker: Marv
steps.content: Obsession, so intense, but... it's blank...

steps.speaker: Marv
steps.content: You have no happiness! Nothing! No food for me! You have no happiness, not at all!
Serpent freezes for a second before turning to Marv, her movements stiff and unnatural.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: What... did you say?

steps.speaker: Marv
steps.content: Your dreams, blank, blank! No happiness! Hahaha! You have no happiness! I'm so hungry...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I've been looking for it for a long, long time, but I've failed. I wish I had it...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: But you... you wanted to eat my happiness?!

steps.speaker: Marv
steps.content: That's something you do not have.
The shackles throb violently, a sign that you're in the presence of a powerful Sinner.
Due to her own obsession or the influence of Endless Carnival, Serpent's Mania level is off the charts.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Perhaps, your death can bring me happiness.
Serpent's snake appears on and wraps itself tightly around Marv. Serpent runs a finger over her captive's chest to where its heart lies and taps on the spot gently.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: It'll take only a moment, and you'll feel very happy too.

steps.speaker: Marv
steps.content: No! Please don't do this! Let me go, I'll give you happiness! Let me live! Live! Happiness!!
Marv stops flapping its wings and falls onto the ground in the white landscape. Squirming, it spits out a lump of sticky substance which gives off a sickly sweet smell.

steps.speaker: Marv
steps.content: My heart, it's Ambrosia. Take it, it'll make you happy!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I was brought here after I drank this. Do you really think... I'll fall for it again?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: But, I accept your surrender.
Serpent squeezes Marv's heart, which then turns into a small bottle, and walks out of the white landscape.
You recognize it. It's the Bottle of Dreams!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I... I have no happiness.

Serpent is in a deranged state of mind upon leaving the Realm of Dreams. The two of you, still linked through the shackles and now back at the gate to the amusement park, see a circus and its wagons drifting past in the bowels of the Rust.
Bringing up the rear is a crowd of Mania-infected monsters in different shapes and forms. They march toward a contaminated, eerie-looking red entrance, disappearing the moment they go through it.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Monsters, just like me...
Serpent roams the streets alone once again, Bottle of Dreams in her hand.
She wants to continue her pursuit of happiness, but the blankness of the Realm of Dreams unsettles her no end.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: No one here... is happy.
Everywhere she looks, tribulations and miseries meet her eyes.
In a dark alley, an elderly woman is on her knees, pleading to a young man standing in front of her.
The voices stops Serpent in her tracks, who looks at them from a distance.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: Please, have mercy! I can't lose this job. I've got a disabled family member and small kids to support!

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: My hands are tied. I did everything I could! I could've just killed you, you know.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: Go now! Before it's too late. My boss might be here at any minute!
What is taking you so long?
You want to die too?!
A door is violently pushed open. A potbellied man walks out of the building into the alley.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: Boss, I... I will kick them out right now!

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: It's been ten minutes! If you don't want this job, just say the word!

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: You can't even handle a simple thing like this. Do I have to do it myself?!

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: No, of course not. I'll do it now, right this second!
The young man wrenches himself free from the old woman hugging his legs, and, ignoring her tearful pleadings, pushes her over and over again.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: Go now! I can't save you. If you stay, I'll die too. And I don't want to die!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: It turned out that these corners where the brilliance of Eastside cannot reach... are as bleak as Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: These dark alleys in Eastside are like black holes, sucking in those who are abandoned by happiness.
Serpent watches as the scene unfolds before her eyes. Her tone is even when she makes the remark, as if she were telling a story.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You poor thing...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: My method of finding happiness doesn't work for me, because I'm a monster. You're a human; it might work for you...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Then, do you want happiness...?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Let me tell you, all of you, how to find happiness, okay?

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: Who... Who are you?

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: It doesn't matter who you are. Help me! Save me! Please!

There is a mountain of garbage in a corner of the alley. In the mix are glass bottles that have broken in half. They once held expensive alcoholic beverages and were thrown away unceremoniously as soon as the contents had been consumed.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Good, good... When you're one of the downtrodden, when you're trapped in the depths of despair...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Weep, be angry, be sad... and after all that, take action.
Serpent is still murmuring, her words mingled with the old woman's crying and the young man's mumbling.
You see Serpent... or you. You are tied together by the shackles. You share each other's emotions and sensations.
You can feel it: you and Serpent take hold of the old woman's hand and guide it toward a broken bottle.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Serpent, don't do it! That won't help her!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That won't solve her problem. It won't make her happy!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Take it easy. Don't be afraid. This is just a story. Or you can think of it as a show!
The old woman, holding the broken bottle, turns to face the potbellied man, who is still ranting and raving not so far away. Serpent urges the woman on, her voice trembling slightly with excitement.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Yes, just like this, go get your happiness!
Piercing shrieks and shrill cries intertwine. Soon enough, a pungent smell fills your nose.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: No, No... What happened?!

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: I didn't want to do this, I didn't... It's her. It's her...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Great, you did it! You took care of everything once and for all. Aren't you feeling better now?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Feeling happy now, huh?
Serpent does a little dance of exultation, whereas the old woman falls on her knees, her face as white as a sheet, shaking all over and making no response to Serpent's question.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: What's wrong? ...You don't seem happy. How can that be...? But you're shaking...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I get it... The happiness you just experienced was short-lived, not enough to offset your past sufferings.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Hmm... Try this then!
You watch as Serpent produces the Bottle of Dreams, hands it to the old woman, and holds her shaking hands stable as she drinks the contents.

In Serpent's Realm of Dreams, a pure white landscape where Marv's heart resides, a painting with moving images appears in midair, which features the old woman and a kid, both smiling. Serpent is standing in front of the painting, admiring it in silence.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Is this happiness? Her happiness...?
Serpent gazes at the painting, lost in thought. After a long while, she suddenly brightens up, like a kid who's just given candy.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I get it now! I totally get it!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: This is how I'm supposed to find happiness!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I should do what Marv did. I should help people by letting them drink Ambrosia and bringing happiness to them! This way, there will be happiness in my Realm of Dreams!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I should decorate it with all of your happiness... This is the way for me to find happiness! My Realm of Dreams won't be blank anymore!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: So...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Let me bring you happiness, okay?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Drink it, and you'll enter a place of endless happiness and sweet dreams.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: This is your reward. You deserve it.
As the voice bounces around in your head, Serpent is walking toward you.
She opens her arms, as if to embrace you.
You raise your head slowly...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Stop bewitching me.
You now know the ins and outs of Serpent's story, about the Bottle of Dreams and about Marv.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Time to bring down the curtain, Serpent.
You can't indulge her any longer.
The mist around you clears; the dark gray walls of the interrogation room come into focus. The two of you have never left.
The floor is now scattered with what looks like magic props used in a circus. No idea how Serpent has managed to pluck them out of thin air.
You're grabbing Serpent's wrist, and she is holding a bottle of pink liquid, trying to force-feed it to you.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You are awake...?!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: It was so close...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: If you had waited for one more second, you'd be experiencing... my "happiness" now.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You are a powerful Sinner, Serpent.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But... You have been put under my shackles.
Still grabbing her wrist, you pull her closer and look straight into her greenish-gray eyes.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Is this the last bottle of Ambrosia?

choices.text: Is this the last bottle of Ambrosia?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The Bottle of Dreams is still working, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Haha... Yes, it is... Because I still need happiness, because I still want to make you happy!
Serpent smiles, tears welling up in her eyes. This gives you a sense of déjà vu. That was how you met before the interrogation.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Why are you crying? I sense you're getting weaker, and your psyche is being eroded.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are you... under the control of the Bottle of Dreams, Serpent?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Tell me where it is. I'll save you, Serpent.
Serpent shakes her head. Her hand holding the bottle, which you're holding up by the wrist, goes limp.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You won't find it... Unless you enter the Realm of Dreams... to search for happiness.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Can... can you really...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If that's the case, I'll do as you wish.
You guide her hand and down the pink liquid.
The sickly sweetness spreads out in your mouth and travels down your throat. Your scalp goes numb.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You are my Sinner... Whatever I tell you to do, you shall follow.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Now let me... into the Realm of Dreams.
